title: Ship navigator · Level 1: Sailing orders
brief: Square your back on the harbour wall and set the heading to 0 (north), then sail the orders: 800 mm on 000 (north), 1000 mm on 090 (east), then 700 mm on 045 (north-east) to the buoy. A buoy is reached when the middle of the robot's axle is inside its green circle. The run ends at the buoy, when the program ends, or at 60 s. 50 for reaching it, up to 40 for speed, 10 for touching no buoy and no wall but the harbour's. Par: 12 s.

score.run: round(if(visitedInOrder == 1, 50 + 40 * min(1, par / max(time, 0.001)), 0) + if(touchesOf_buoy1 + touchesOf_wallW + touchesOf_wallE + touchesOf_wallN == 0, 10, 0), 1)
